note: Counts are scheduled fits/bundles before explicit identical-config aliases; OOF bundles contain 18 expert fits each. No Cartesian tuning expansion.

ablation_coefficient_reference.rule: All five flags are compared with the fixed nonzero anchor parent; selected primary remains separate and may have zero aggregation coefficients. Do not restrict candidate grid.

protocol.embargo: exclude December2007/2010/2016 labels from roles; OOF fit_end <= first heldout target minus2 months
protocol.interpretation: revised archival hindcast; availability scenarios, five fixed regions; no historically-vintaged prospective evaluation claim

latency.frozen_hyperparameters: reuse main FULL choices without retuning

neural.checkpoint_selection: best macro outer-validation R2; all 60 rounds, no early stopping
neural.coefficient_selector: CAAA global; same frozen algorithm emits global and personal identities
neural.exact_ties: smaller learning rate; smaller mu; coefficient anchor (.3,.3,.4), then lexicographic
neural.mu_selector: global CAAA/FedProx; personal Ditto/each named graph
neural.shared_lr_selector: FULL FedAvg global, seed42, baseline-favoring shared choice

router.robust_objective: .65 calibration overall R2 + .35 calibration last-half R2
router.score_interpretation: heldout score belongs to provisional calibration weights, not final refit weights
router.stack: training temporal OOF standardized Ridge alpha10

protocol.runtime_reproducibility: Freeze Python/OS/architecture, seven scientific-library versions and PyTorch build/git signature; reject dependency changes on fit/evaluation resume. Runtime directory relocation is allowed.
protocol.selected_rule: three fixed groups; alpha10 Ridge; gain >=.002 vs CORE; training-only chronological folds
protocol.sign_randomization: optional; block12 + Holm over this full predeclared family

supplements.GLDAS: disabled until root supplies matched 2001-04 start cohort; no old three-fold selector
supplements.IMD: disabled until root supplies matched complete-case cohort

protocol.true_core_climate_free: CORE14; no climate embedding, weighting or adaptive prox, zero ENSO/IOD drivers and sensitivity; requires separately matched CORE reference
